description:
Stop spending hours pulling together your weekly report. 

In this step-by-step demo, Eunji from Data Science shows how she sets up a recurring task in ChatGPT Work. Once it’s scheduled, ChatGPT Work pulls the latest metrics, explains what changed, updates the charts, and drafts the Slack message every week—so Eunji starts each Thursday with a complete first draft ready to review.
